title: Élyséa's Lore
prerequisite: Elf, Drow, Fir Bolg or Halfling
description: Élyséa's magic has pulsed in your blood since your birth. The first time you {{memorisee|memorise}} this Skill, unlock a Domain Tree you do not have yet for free, and {{apprise|learn}} the Skill at the heart of that Tree without paying for it.
